currentParagraphText: “No, you need to use the exact words that refer to the god,” Minaga said. “Of course, the actual words won’t be the same due to translations and whatnot, but the meaning of the title or name used has to be exact. So, if you refer to me as that handsome devil or the Supreme Maker of Labyrinths, it has no effect, but if you use All-God Legion or Minaga, I’ll vaguely be aware of it. Especially when it’s people I’m already mentally aware of who do it.”
